storage.value:
As a system user

I want to be able to create a new penalty

So that I can better manage contract administration and payment activities

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Penalty creation is possible from penalties listing page by clicking on a 'Plus' button in the list.

    1. It is also possible to open penalty creation page from Product/service creation page by clicking on a ‘Plus' button on 'Select Penalty’ Modal; It will open a new page in a new browser window;

    2. It is also possible to open Penalty creation page from Penalty group page by clicking on a 'Plus' button on Penalty Modal; It will open a new page in a new browser window;

  2. Check system user permissions to be able to create new Penalty

    1. Permission - Create Penalty

      1. Enable Plus button when user has permission

      2. Disable Plus button when user doesn’t have permission

  3. Penalty object contains fields:

    1. Name

      1. Mandatory 

      2. Text field 

      3. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

      4. Length 1-1024 characters 

    2. Contract clause number

      1. Optional 

      2. Text field 

      3. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

      4. Length 1-2048 characters

    3. Action type

      1. Mandatory

      2. Multi select dropdown

      3. Same nomenclature which is used in action “action type”

      4. Action type should be Under contract clause field and width should be same as additional information 

      5. When user has penalty create/edit permission, system should allow to see action type nomenclature on penalty’s Create/Edit/Preview modes

    4. Trigger process

      1. Will be implemented in contract module

    5. Code to start from a process

      1. Will be implemented in contract module

    6. Penalty payer

      1. Checkbox

      2. Mandatory to select at least one option

      3. Predefined hardcoded values:

        1. ENERGO-PRO

        2. Customer

    7. Applicability

      1. Radio Button

      2. Mandatory

      3. Predefined hardcoded values:

        1. Contract

        2. Points of Delivery

        3. Event

    8. Amount

      1. Optional

      2. Text area

      3. Decimals can be used in formula creation

        1. In penalty object amount field, on create/edit mode when add formula variables from formulas dropdown, should add $ before and after formula variable.

      4. To be able to add the amount of the penalty through a formula and the use of numeric parameters defined in the contract or variables

      5. in the Amount, values should be formatted differently so the user will know that something from the system is added and not just typed ( Format Blue color + Bold) objects which should have different format:

        1. Penalties parameter

        2. Price parameter

        3. Price component

      6. Parameters which can be used in formula:

        1. Penalties parameter

          1. which can be added by Add button

        2. Price parameter

          1. display active price parameters

          2. which can be added by Add button (separate add button)

        3. Price component

          1. display all distinct price component tags, from price component which is used in product version where this penalty is added.

          2. Price components tags

            1. In formula should be used exact price component tag.

            2. should check in respective product’s version (which is add in respective contract’s version) all price component and all price components from group of price components. any of them in formula is used profile or price parameter , ignore them

            3. if there is not left any of price component display error “there is not valid price component in calculation”

            4. if used price component tag is more then 1 display error “There is more then 1 price component for used price component tag in calculation”.

            5. I if used price component tag is only 1 then used it in calculation

              1. in formula should ignore condition field from price component

          3. which can be added by Add button (separate add button)

        4. Operators which can be used in formula:

          1. Add

          2. Addition

          3. Subtraction

          4. Multiplication

          5. Division

          6. Bracket left

          7. Bracket right

        5. Penalty calculation process should start from action create/edit mode after clicking save button

        6. If in penalty field are selected “without penalty” value, system shouldn’t start calculation process

        7. System should calculate penalty which are selected in action from “penalty” dropdown field

          1. System should check amount field in selected penalty and if any of used formula variables can’t be calculated shouldn’t calculate penalty

          2. System should check amount field in selected penalty and if all used formula variables can be calculated calculate penalty amount

    9. Minimum amount

      1. Optional

      2. Text field

      3. Only digits can be added. Negative values and zero are not allowed can’t be added, valid decimal number with 2 digits after the decimal point

      4. Length: 15 digits, 0.01-999999999999.99

      5. Should be less than Maximum amount

      6. To be able to set minimum amount of penalty

    10. Maximum amount

      1. Optional

      2. Text field

      3. Only digits can be added. Negative values and zero are not allowed can’t be added, valid decimal number with 2 digits after the decimal point

      4. Length: 15 digits, 0.01-999999999999.99

      5. Should be more than minimum amount

      6. To be able to set minimum amount of penalty

    11. Currency

      1. Always mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown  

      3. List is manageable from nomenclature  

      4. Active values will be returned from nomenclature  

      5. Order should be considered   

      6. Display default if returned from nomenclature 

    12. Automatic submission

      1. Optional

      2. Checkbox

    13. Additional information

      1. Optional 

      2. Text area

      3. All symbols are allowed + NL. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

      4. Length: 1-4096 characters

    14. Payment term

      1. Mandatory

      2. It is possible to add only one payment by clicking on a Plus button in right panel

        1. Payment term is already implemented with differences:

        2. Value: should be mandatory

        3. Value to/from should be empty and disabled

        4. Detailed fields validation is described below

      3. After creating payment term will be listed in penalty creation page.

    15. To be able to select

      1. No interest on overdue debts

        1. Optional

        2. Checkbox

  4. Clicking on a ‘Save’ button will check all the validations in frontend:

    1. If validations are failed stop process display error messages

    2. If frontend validations are successful then a confirmation pop-up is displayed with two buttons – confirm and cancel. Clicking the cancel button return to penalty filling form

    3. Clicking on confirm button interim and penalty creation request should be sent In backend

      1. Warning messages should be managed via system messages configuration

    4. If an error happens display with proper field

    5. If there is more than one error, system should display all the errors in interface

    6. If backend validations are successful then create a new Interim and penalty

    7. Create Audit log record

  5. Clicking on Cancel button or ‘X’ button

    1. Check changes and if there are changes made then Warning Pop-up message comes out with buttons:

      1. ‘Your changes are not saved, are you sure you want to cancel?’ No, Yes

      2. No - will close warning Pop-up and stay on interim and penalty creation page

      3. Yes – will close Pop-up and return to previous page

      4. Warning messages should be managed via system messages configuration 

  6. Audit Log  

    1. Audit Log record should be created on adding/Editing/Removing actions   

    2. No need to create Audit Log record on Move to top/Drag & Drop 

  7. Dark mode

    1. By default system’s color is light mode

    2. it is possible to switch system’s color to Dark mode by clicking on 'Dark Mode' icon in header; Clicking again will switch to light mode

  8. Tab navigation

    1. To be able to have keyboard navigation via tab, shift tab, Enter/space keys (left-right)

    2. Disabled fields should be skipper

 Sub-Object

Fields Validations for payment term:

  1. Type

    1. Mandatory

    2. Single Select Dropdown

    3. No need to select default value in dropdown

    4. Hardcoded values:

      1. Working Days (Ð Ð°Ð±Ð¾ÑÐ½Ð¸ Ð´Ð½Ð¸)

        1. Considers holidays and weekends from predefined calendar

        2. All three fields are active in Modal window

      2. Calendar Days (ÐÐ°Ð»ÐµÐ½Ð´Ð°ÑÐ½Ð¸ Ð´Ð½Ð¸)

        1. Doesn’t excludes any day from calendar (includes weekends and public holidays)

        2. All three fields are active in Modal window

      3. Certain day of the month (Ð¢Ð¾ÑÐ½Ð° Ð´Ð°ÑÐ°)

        1. Customer should add exact day of a month in which day customer should pay

        2. All three fields are active in Modal window

  2. Value

    1. Mandatory

    2. Text field

    3. Only digits can be added

      1. If Type is set to working days or calendar date

        1. Number should be between 0-9999

        2. Length: max 4 characters

        3. Negative values and zero are not allowed can’t be added

        4. Display warning message if doesn’t match validation

      2. If Type is set to Certain day of the month option

        1. Number should be between 1-31 (if 29, 30 or 31 is selected and the month does not contain such a date, it means the last day of the month)

        2. Length: max 4 characters

        3. Negative values and zero are not allowed can’t be added

        4. Display warning message if doesn’t match validation

    4. For all three types is active and it is possible to add exact value

  3. Value from

    1. Empty

    2. Disabled

  4. Value to

    1. Empty

    2. Disabled

  5. Calendar

    1. Mandatory

    2. Single select dropdown

      1. List is manageable from nomenclature

        1. Active values will be returned from nomenclature

        2. Order should be considered

        3. Display Search Bar if number of items are more than 10 items in dropdown list

        4. While typing search letter list in dropdown should be filtered by search letters

        5. Display default if returned from nomenclature

  6. Exclude for due date

    1. Optional

    2. If Type is selected Working days, the checkboxes „Weekends“ and „Holidays“ should be disabled and empty

    3. Checkboxes

      1. Weekends – will replace weekends (depending selected Calendar)

      2. Holidays – will replace holidays (depending selected Calendar)

    4. If select checkbox than invoice payment due day will be replaced with previous or next working day (depending selected in “Change due date to’ ratio buttons))

  7. Change due date to

    1. Optional

    2. When checkboxes Weekends or Holidays are not selected, the radio buttons “Change due date to” should also be disabled and empty

    3. Radio Button

    4. Hardcoded values:

      1. Previous working day

        1. If Invoice payment due day matches holidays or weekend (depending selected in Exclude checkboxes and selected Calendar)invoice payment due date will be changed in previous working day (depending selected Calendar)

      2. Next working day (preselected)

        1. If Invoice payment due day matches holiday or weekend (depending selected in Exclude checkboxes and selected Calendar)invoice payment due date will be changed in next working day (depending selected Calendar)

  8. Clicking on Ok button will check validations (frontend side only)

    1. Will display error messages if doesn’t match validations

    2. If all validations are successful will close pop-up and display in previous page created payment term object with following structure:

      1. If Value is added - 5 working days (Exclude Weekends, Holidays, change to Next working day)

      2. if Value range is added - 5 -10 working days (Exclude Weekends, Holidays, change to Next working day)

      3. if Only Holidays are excluded - 5 -10 working days (Exclude Holidays, change to Next working day)

      4. if Holidays and Weekends are not excluded - 5 -10 working days

      5. If certain day of the month is added – 15 day of the month

      6. If certain day of the month range is added – 5-15 day of the month

      7. if some fields in payment term are edited and try to close the main object without saving the warning message should appear

    3. Actual saving in DB will be performed with main object saving process

    4. List will be sorted by creation date ASC (newly added payment date will be listed as last record)

  9. Clicking on Cancel button or ‘X’ button

    • Check changes and if there are changes made then Warning Pop-up message comes out with buttons

      • ‘Your changes are not saved, are you sure you want to cancel?’ No, Yes

      • No - will close warning Pop-up and return to previous page

      • Yes – will close Payment term Pop-up and return to previous page

      • Warning messages should be managed via system messages configuration

List of penalties variables:

PARAMETER

DESCRIPTION

Total estimated contract consumption (for the entire initial term of the contract for all PODs)
